files.text:
# Ferrowick product notes

Working notes for the Ferrowick app: plans, meeting notes and checklists.

Start with plans/q3-launch.md.

# Q3 launch: disruption and rebooking

Goal: when weather cancels a sailing, passengers rebook in two taps and keep the fare they paid.

In scope:
- Operations can mark a sailing at risk
- Rebooking onto the next sailing
- Disruption updates by SMS for passengers without the app

Target: 14 November, with or without the waitlist.

# Q3 launch: open questions

- Do we waive the fare difference on every route, or only on the long crossings?
- Who signs off the SMS wording, operations or support?
- The waitlist may slip. The launch can go without it.

# 予約確認メールの翻訳

日本語の予約確認メールには、出航日と港の名前を必ず入れること。翻訳のレビューは来週の水曜日。

# Launch checklist

- [x] Release notes drafted
- [ ] Store screenshots updated
- [ ] Support briefed on fare waivers
- [ ] Crew handsets updated before the first sailing

# Встреча с отделом эксплуатации

Обсудили отмены рейсов из-за погоды. Решение: пассажиры получают SMS за два часа до отправления.

# Plan, with a capital P

Next year: offline tickets first, then group bookings.

# plan, in lower case

This month: fix the scanner sunlight bug before the winter timetable.

# On-board café, composed name

The café on the long crossings takes cards only from November.

# On-board café, decomposed name

The café menu moves into the app next spring.
